component_policy: Web r35 retains accepted r34 fixes and restores original invoice amounts only for historical invoices without cost snapshots. New subscriber sales use their recorded package cost, including zero; explicitly unavailable new costs remain unavailable. This is a read-only report projection; financial history, quota counters and all non-Web images remain unchanged. Runtime SQL is unchanged from r34.
deployment_limits: Manual installer only; does not distribute an update to existing customers.
Hosted tenant updates require target wrapper, mounts, binding, controller protocol and lease preflight.
Optional hosted RADIUS probe companion is separate, not installed by this runtime bundle.
WhatsApp and unproven idle RAM experiments are excluded.
